name: near-ai-vscode
description: Private AI agents for coding, research, presales, writing, and data work: TEE-backed NEAR AI models, Open-GSD project workflows, and the cost of every answer.

chatParticipants.name: nearai
chatParticipants.description: Chat with private NEAR AI models and run Open-GSD workflows.

nearAi.baseUrl.description: NEAR AI Cloud API base URL.

nearAi.defaultModel.description: Model used for new chats. If NEAR AI doesn't offer it, the first available chat model is used.

nearAi.actionPolicy.description: How much the agent may do without asking. Every file change can be reverted from the chat.
enumDescriptions: File edits and shell commands ask first; reads and searches run automatically.
File edits run automatically; shell commands still ask unless allow-listed.

Auto approve: file edits run, and shell commands run when they pass the safety check. Clear cases are decided by fixed rules (builds, tests, and read-only git run; pushes, deletes, publishing, and credential paths ask); only commands the rules cannot decide go to a private (TEE) model, and anything it cannot clear asks.
Everything runs without asking except deny-listed commands. Use only in throwaway workspaces.

nearAi.autoInstallGsd.description: Install Open-GSD into the extension's storage the first time you run a workflow, and keep it on the latest stable release in projects set up with NEAR AI. Your ~/.claude setup is never touched.

enumDescriptions: Any NEAR AI model can be used; each is labelled private or forwarded.
Only models NEAR runs in an attested TEE can be used; messages to forwarded models are blocked.
nearAi.privacyMode.description: Whether chats may use models that NEAR AI forwards to other providers.

nearAi.dailySpendLimitUsd.description: Stop sending NEAR AI requests once today's spend reaches this amount in USD: NEAR AI Cloud's own total for your API key when a usage reporting token is set, or this computer's spend ledger (confirmed plus pending), whichever is higher. Checked before every request and every model turn. 0 means no limit.

enumDescriptions: Today starts at midnight on this computer's clock.
nearAi.spend.dayBoundary.description: When "today" starts for spend figures and nearAi.dailySpendLimitUsd.

nearAi.spend.useNearUsageTotal.markdownDescription: Match the NEAR AI console exactly by using NEAR's own usage total for your API key (in every spend figure and for `#nearAi.dailySpendLimitUsd#`) when a usage reporting token is set; off, figures are this computer's spend ledger. The token is stored in VS Code's encrypted secret storage, never in settings. [Set usage reporting token](command:nearAi.setUsageReportingToken) · [Clear](command:nearAi.clearUsageReportingToken) · How to create one: an organization owner or admin calls `POST /v1/organizations/{org_id}/reporting-tokens` with a NEAR AI Cloud console session token (it is not in the console UI); it starts with `rpt-`.

nearAi.agent.allowCommands.description: Shell commands the agent may run without asking, matched by their leading words ("git push" covers "git push origin main", but never --force or a URL). The approval card's "Always allow" adds entries here. In Auto approve mode each part of a chained command (cd app && git push) is matched on its own; in other modes, commands that chain, redirect, or substitute always ask. The deny list is checked first.

nearAi.agent.denyCommands.description: Shell commands the agent is never allowed to run, matched as substrings, whatever the action policy.

nearAi.agent.deepModel.description: Model for Open-GSD sub-agents in the deep tier (opus). If your provider does not offer it, the chat's model is used.

nearAi.agent.standardModel.description: Model for Open-GSD sub-agents in the standard tier (sonnet). If your provider does not offer it, the chat's model is used.

nearAi.agent.fastModel.description: Model for Open-GSD sub-agents in the fast tier (haiku). If your provider does not offer it, the chat's model is used.

nearAi.agent.safetyModel.description: Model that checks shell commands the rules cannot decide when nearAi.actionPolicy is auto. Empty uses the fast tier (nearAi.agent.fastModel). It is used only when it runs privately (in NEAR's TEE or on a local runtime); otherwise those commands ask.

nearAi.agent.maxParallelAgents.description: How many sub-agents may run at the same time.

nearAi.agent.maxTurns.description: The most model turns one agent run (or sub-agent) may take before it stops and asks you to continue.

nearAi.agent.saveTranscripts.description: Save full conversations (including file contents the agent read) in VS Code's extension storage on this machine so they can be resumed from History. Never saved in the project.

nearAi.agent.visionModel.description: Reads image attachments when the chat's model can't (private by default).

nearAi.agent.imageModel.description: Model the agent's GenerateImage tool uses (private by default). The tool is offered only when your provider lists this model.

nearAi.activity.retentionMinutes.description: How long the agents' prompts, replies, and tool calls are kept for Agent Activity's "Export details", in minutes. They are kept in memory only and dropped after this; the overview's counts are kept in the project's activity history.

nearAi.activity.maxMegabytes.description: The most memory those entries use, in MB. The oldest are dropped first; per-agent totals are kept.

enumDescriptions: Ask once per project before the first check.
Check every NEAR AI project when it opens and when its lockfiles change.
Never check automatically; the command still works after you agree.
nearAi.security.scanOnOpen.description: Check a NEAR AI project's dependencies and runtimes for known vulnerabilities (OSV.dev, endoflife.date) when it opens. Only package names and versions are sent.

enumDescriptions: Agents cannot search; they can still fetch pages they know.
Brave Search API (key set with NEAR AI: Set Up Web Search).
Tavily (key set with NEAR AI: Set Up Web Search).
nearAi.webSearch.provider.description: Which search provider the agents' WebSearch tool uses. Queries go to that provider.

nearAi.webSearch.searxngUrl.description: Base URL of your SearXNG instance (https, or http for localhost), with JSON output enabled.

nearAi.agent.maxRunCostUsd.description: Stops a run (the agent and all its sub-agents) once its estimated cost reaches this many US dollars; never more than what is left of nearAi.dailySpendLimitUsd. Its work is kept.

nearAi.agent.maxRunTokens.description: Stops a run (the agent and all its sub-agents) once it has used this many tokens on models without published prices; priced models are bounded by nearAi.agent.maxRunCostUsd instead. Its work is kept.

nearAi.agent.shellEnvAllow.description: Environment variables to pass to the agent's shell even though they look like credentials (for example GITHUB_TOKEN for gh). Others whose names or values look like keys, tokens, or passwords are kept out, because the agent's commands could send them to the model.

nearAi.agent.approvalTimeoutMinutes.description: How long an action waiting for your approval waits before it is declined, so an unattended run carries on without it (the agent is told and reports what still needs you). 0 waits indefinitely.

nearAi.agent.maxOutputTokens.description: Most output tokens (reasoning included) one agent reply may use, never more than the model allows. A reply cut off at the limit is followed by a request to continue more concisely.

nearAi.agent.roleModels.markdownDescription: Model for each agent role: a tier (`deep`, `standard`, `fast`) or a NEAR model ID, by agent name or a `*` pattern. Research and mapping roles read large inputs in parallel, so they default to the cheaper fast tier (GLM 5.3 Flash). A team member's own `model:` line wins, and an agent never uses a model less private than the chat's.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run sbom && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links
scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run -a node dist/test/e2e/run.js
